articles.title: Expedito Netto promete crédito de até R$ 21 mil para trabalhadores | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato ao governo de Rondônia foi sabatinado no JRO1 nesta quarta-feira (16). Ele também defendeu a substituição de processos seletivos por concursos públicos e explicou seu voto a favor do impeachment de Dilma Rousseff em 2016.
articles.summary: Em sabatina ao JRO1, Expedito Netto (PT)  também defendeu a substituição de processos seletivos por concursos públicos e explicou seu voto a favor do impeachment de Dilma.
articles.body:
O candidato a governador de Rondônia Expedito Netto ( PT ) prometeu criar um banco voltado ao trabalhador, com o objetivo de financiar equipamentos e empreendimentos com linhas de crédito de até R$ 21 mil, priorizando mães solo e jovens. A proposta foi apresentada durante entrevista realizada nesta quarta-feira (16) no Jornal de Rondônia 1ª Edição (JRO1). (Assista à íntegra da entrevista acima)

“Eu irei conceder um crédito de R$ 1 a R$ 21 mil para aquelas pessoas que desejam obter as suas novas ferramentas de trabalho. A sua moto, o que você precisa para ser feirante, o que você precisa para ser manicure, tudo o que você pode pensar para iniciar uma nova profissão ou iniciar um novo trabalho", disse o candidato.

Expedito destacou que os valores serão prioritários para as mães solo, como forma de promover independência financeira e ajudar no enfrentamento à violência doméstica. Ele também afirmou que pretende criar um incentivo fiscal para empresas que contratarem mulheres vítimas de abuso.

➡️ A Rede Amazônica realiza, ao longo desta semana, entrevistas com os quatro candidatos ao governo de Rondônia mais bem posicionados na pesquisa Quaest de 25 de agosto, que atingiram no mínimo 5% das intenções de voto. As sabatinas são conduzidas pela apresentadora Beatriz Maciel.

Expedito Netto tem passagens pelo PSDB, Solidariedade e PSD, e agora concorre ao governo pelo PT. Questionado sobre as trocas partidárias ao longo dos anos, ele afirmou que iniciou a trajetória influenciado pelo pai e mudou de legenda conforme foi amadurecendo.

“Quando quis entrar na política pelos meus próprios passos, quis ir para o Solidariedade, que era um partido que representava mais o contexto do que eu acredito, que era a defesa dos direitos trabalhistas. Cheguei em Brasília, tive um partido que queria me impor as minhas votações. E aí fui para o PSD. O PSD foi um partido que sempre me deu liberdade”, justificou.

Netto finalizou afirmando que foi escolhido pelo presidente Lula para representar o PT em Rondônia. No entanto, foi confrontado pela apresentadora por ter votado a favor do impeachment de Dilma Rousseff em 2016. Na ocasião, Expedito proferiu a seguinte frase no plenário: "Amanhã a senhora e o PT encerram a sua carreira. E o Brasil, mais uma vez, vai poder voltar a florescer”.

“Não há nada que faça que eu possa mudar o que eu fiz na minha juventude. Hoje sou uma nova pessoa, enxergo as coisas com novos olhares. Eu acho que errar nunca vai ser o problema. Errar é humano. Se manter no erro é que é uma burrice”, declarou.

Processos seletivos e concursos públicos

O candidato foi incisivo nas críticas ao uso de processos seletivos no serviço público de Rondônia. Ele defendeu o fim da modalidade e a substituição por concursos públicos.

“Talvez o remédio seja aceitar um governo que realmente valoriza o servidor público, que acaba com essa questão de processo seletivo, porque processo seletivo é casa alugada. Concurso público é casa própria”, comparou.

Netto prometeu a realização de concursos, especialmente para a área da segurança pública, o que ele considera a solução para melhorar os índices de violência no estado.

“Nós temos que fazer concurso público, fazer um treinamento adequado, porque se o policial não tiver parceiro para ir para a rua, ele não vai enfrentar o crime organizado, ele não vai estar lá preparado para poder te defender”, opinou.

Atualmente, Rondônia possui a 2ª maior taxa de feminicídio do país, segundo o Anuário do Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública. Por outro lado, existem apenas oito delegacias da mulher no estado — sendo que a da capital não possui sede própria — e nenhuma funciona em regime de 24 horas.

Perguntado sobre o tema, Expedito prometeu ampliar o número de unidades e o tempo de funcionamento dessas delegacias. Segundo ele, há um número expressivo de delegados e agentes ocupando cargos políticos ou administrativos, que deveriam atuar no enfrentamento direto à violência.

“Hoje nós temos delegados com desvio de função, trabalhando dentro da máquina pública. É por isso que as delegacias não funcionam 24 horas”, declarou.

Expedito também prometeu a implementação de tecnologias para rastrear agressores. Pela proposta, a vítima e as delegacias teriam acesso à localização do agressor 24 horas por dia, por meio do celular. Entretanto, o candidato não detalhou como essa tecnologia seria desenvolvida ou aplicada na prática.

Em um estado de perfil majoritariamente conservador, Expedito foi questionado sobre como pretende lidar com os conflitos agrários, especialmente os que envolvem o Movimento dos Trabalhadores Rurais Sem Terra (MST) e a Liga dos Camponeses Pobres (LCP).

Ao responder, o candidato criticou a atuação da LCP, definindo-a como uma organização armada responsável por invasões violentas de propriedades.

Para rebater o receio de que uma gestão progressista comprometeria os proprietários rurais, o candidato classificou o discurso sobre o risco de perda de terras como um "teatro" utilizado para manipular a população.

"Isso é um teatro, a venda de um velho medo para tentar se impor à população, para tentar vender um medo sobre o que a gente do campo progressista realmente defende. Ninguém aqui é contra a propriedade privada”, concluiu.

articles.title: Atlético de Madrid - Osasuna: horario y dónde ver en TV hoy el partido de LaLiga EA Sports
articles.standfirst: Se enfrentan hoy en el Riyadh Air Metropolitano en el partido correspondiente a la jornada 6 de LaLiga EA Sports
articles.summary: Se enfrentan hoy en el Riyadh Air Metropolitano en el partido correspondiente a la jornada 6 de LaLiga EA Sports
articles.body: El Atlético de Madrid regresa al Metropolitano cuatro partidos después. Dos triunfos y dos derrotas. Ahora toca volver a casa tras un último partido como locales de lo más accidentado. Un empate ante el Villarreal en medio de una tormenta de pitos, sobre todo a Julián Alvarez. Osasuna, el miércoles, y el derbi ante el Real Madrid, el domingo. Dos duelos en casa antes de marcharse al parón de selecciones para irse con las mejores sensaciones posibles. Los de Simeone llegan al partido contra los rojillos tras ganar a la Real Sociedad, mientras que Osasuna llega tras perder contra el Espanyol. En clave rojilla, está la necesidad de cortar el regusto que han dejado las dos últimas derrotas consecutivas y por la necesidad de superar el estado de shock al que ha llevado la repentina marcha de Braulio Vázquez rumbo al Valencia. El partido entre Atlético de Madrid y Osasuna de la jornada 6 de LaLiga EA Sports se juega el miércoles 16 de septiembre a las 19:00 horas. El partido entre Atlético de Madrid y Osasuna de la jornada 6 de LaLiga EA Sports se podrá ver por televisión en directo a través del canal Movistar LaLiga. También se podrá seguir el partido a través de la narración de Radio MARCA y con los comentarios en directo de MARCA.com. Desde dos horas antes, sigue la previa y los onces. Tras el encuentro, podrás leer la crónica, las declaraciones de los protagonistas y ver el resumen con las mejores jugadas y los goles. El Atlético de Madrid llega al partido contra Osasuna de LaLiga EA Sports tras ganar a la Real Sociedad, se encuentra en la posición número 4 de LaLiga EA Sports con 10 puntos. Osasuna llega al partido contra Atlético de Madrid tras perder contra el Espanyol, se encuentra en la posición número 11 con 7 puntos.

articles.title: Yves Bissouma, el último 'regalo' de Jordi Cruyff a Míchel: "Quiero ganarlo todo"
articles.standfirst: El ex de Lille, Brighton y Tottenham, que estaba sin equipo, firma hasta junio de 2027
articles.summary: El ex de Lille, Brighton y Tottenham, que estaba sin equipo, firma hasta junio de 2027
articles.body: Jordi Cruyff no para. Ni con el mercado cerrado. El Ajax ha llegado a un acuerdo con Yves Bissouma (Issia, 1996) para que se incorpore a las órdenes de Míchel. El ex de Lille, Brighton y Tottenham, que estaba sin equipo, firma por una temporada, hasta junio de 2027. Se convierte, de este modo, en el duodécimo fichaje del Ajax este verano. Se une a Marc-André Ter Stegen, Julian Brandt, Sofyan Amrabat, Daley Blind, Marcos Leonardo, Simon Adingra, Thilo Keherer, Jofre Torrents, Viktor Tsygankov, Caio Henrique y Tolu Arokodare. "Las conversaciones con Yves comenzaron en agosto y estamos encantados de que finalmente haya firmado con nosotros. Con él, hemos incorporado a un jugador experimentado que sabe cómo funcionan las cosas al más alto nivel. Es versátil y puede jugar en varias posiciones, y esperamos que pueda jugar lo antes posible", ha asegurado Jordi Cruyff al referirse al internacional por Mali. "Soy un ganador, y quiero ganarlo todo. Ése es mi deseo. Estoy listo para empezar", asegura Bissouma, que lucirá el dorsal 28. "Soy alguien que siempre está ahí para sus compañeros, para demostrarles que podemos hacerlo mejor, que podemos dar más. Eso es parte de mí. No soy el entrenador, pero como dije, estoy aquí para aportar mi granito de arena", insiste.

articles.title: Max Dowman shines again for Arsenal and JJ Gabriel wants Man Utd exit, so which clubs have most valuable teens? Between the Lines
articles.summary: The Premier League's young sensations are making waves but which clubs have the most valuable teens? Between the Lines, the Sky Sports strand breaking down the data behind football's big stories, takes a look using Transfermarkt valuations
articles.body:
Dowman, 16, scored twice in Arsenal's Carabao Cup win over Ipswich, only hours after 15-year-old Gabriel had stunned Manchester United with his request to cancel his registration at the club.

Dowman's breakthrough and Gabriel's desire for first-team opportunities show how the stars of tomorrow are starting younger, but which Premier League clubs have the most valuable teens?

For this week's Between the Lines , we use Transfermarkt valuations to rank Premier League clubs by teenage value, albeit with the caveat that Transfermarkt does not assign valuations to young players with no first-team experience such as Gabriel.

According to Transfermarkt , Manchester City have the most valuable teenagers at a combined £122.6m, putting them just ahead of Chelsea on £121m, and Arsenal in third on £102.4m.

Brighton have the fourth-highest teenage value at £100.7m, reflecting their knack for identifying high-potential young signings in the transfer market, and putting them well ahead of fifth-placed Liverpool , who have a teenage value of £64.3m.

Manchester United set the standard for youth development in the Sir Alex Ferguson era but their teen value of £48.1m suggests they are no longer a top destination for young players and leaves them sixth, just ahead of Hull , who punch above their weight in seventh.

Ipswich have no teenagers assigned Transfermarkt values, leaving them bottom of the rankings, while Newcastle and Everton also stand out in the lower half of the rankings with teen values of only £9.9m and £10.5m respectively.

Spurs have the lowest teenage value of the traditional big six clubs, their total value of £23.1m putting them 11th.

Ayyoub Bouaddi , signed from Lille in August, accounts for over half of Manchester City's total, with a Transfermarkt value of £68.6m.

The 18-year-old midfielder sits alongside Chelsea winger Estevao as the most valuable teenager in the Premier League.

The next-most valuable teenager is centre-back Luka Vuskovic , who joined Brighton from Spurs for £50m in the summer and is valued by Transfermarkt at £51.4m.

Arsenal's total teen value is spread wider than their rivals'. In Myles Lewis-Skelly , Ethan Nwaneri and Max Dowman , who are valued at £38.6m, £30m and 25.7m respectively, the Gunners have three players among the 10 most valuable teenagers.

Dowman, who became the Premier League's youngest goalscorer aged 16 years and 73 days last season, is the only 16-year-old at any Premier League club with a Transfermarkt valuation.

Liverpool's 18-year-old winger Rio Ngumoha also features among the top 10, with the same Transfermarkt value as Dowman at £25.7m, along with Manchester United's Ayden Heaven , 19, and Aston Vila's Ibrahim Mbaye , 18.

The only five other teenagers with Transfermarkt v alues of over £20m are Brighton's Charalampos Kostoulas , Fulham's Josh King , Hull's Christos Mouzakitis , Liverpool's Giovanni Leoni and Sunderland's Chris Rigg .

Bouaddi and Estevao account for over half of Manchester City and Chelsea's total teenage values having been signed from Lille and Palmeiras at considerable expense, but Arsenal seemingly have an edge when it comes to generating value from their academy.

In addition to Lewis-Skelly, Dowman and the on-loan Nwaneri, all of whom are graduates of the club's Hale End youth system, the Gunners have 17-year-old defender Marli Salmon.

Like Dowman, Salmon impressed against Ipswich on Tuesday. His Transfermarkt value of £4.3m makes him the third-most valuable 17-year-old in the Premier League behind only Manchester City's Jeremy Monga and Aston Villa's Brian Madjo, both of whom were signed from other clubs in the summer.

Among the Premier League's 20 most valuable teenagers, according to Transfermarkt , the only players beyond Lewis-Skelly, Nwaneri and Dowman who came through the youth ranks at their current clubs are Fulham's King, Sunderland's Rigg and Tottenham winger Mikey Moore, who is on loan at Koln.

Heaven, who joined Manchester United from Arsenal last year, is another graduate of Hale End, further underlining the strength of the Gunners' production line.

Speaking on Sky Sports News, Paul Merson highlighted the importance of patience, specifically in the cases of Arsenal's Dowman and Manchester United's Gabriel.

"He's going past players like they're not there, like he's playing in his own age group," Merson said on Dowman.

"The first goal on Tuesday, the way he throws the dummy, leaves the defender on his backside and scores. It's just unbelievable.

"He's at an unbelievable Rolls Royce of a football club. He's got 15 years at least at the top. He's just got to be patient and that's hard because he'll think that he should be playing in the team now."

On Gabriel, Merson added: "First of all, he's an unbelievable talent. This kid can play as well. The problem now is with the lad and probably his agents and his family. I don't know him, so I'm only thinking from the outside.

"When you're watching Max Dowman and Rio Ngumoha getting given a chance at Liverpool and doing very well, he's probably thinking, I should be playing at Man United now as well.

"This is the problem you're going to have with the kids now of this day and age. They're so talented that they want to play straight away. When I was playing, it was unheard of at 16."

articles.title: El recogepelotas que hizo perder los nervios a Hazard, ante el 'pelotazo' de su vida
articles.standfirst: Charlie Morgan, el adolescente que protagonizó el famoso incidente con Eden Hazard en 2013, vende la marca Au Vodka en una operación valorada en 300 millones de libras
articles.summary: Charlie Morgan, el adolescente que protagonizó el famoso incidente con Eden Hazard en 2013, vende la marca Au Vodka en una operación valorada en 300 millones de libras
articles.body: Para muchos aficionados, el nombre de Morgan quedó grabado para siempre en aquella semifinal de la Copa de la Liga inglesa disputada entre Swansea City y Chelsea en enero de 2013. Con el conjunto galés defendiendo su ventaja, el joven recogepelotas retuvo el balón junto a la línea de fondo. La desesperación de Hazard por acelerar el juego desembocó en una acción que dio la vuelta al mundo y que acabó con la expulsión del entonces futbolista belga. Aquel episodio convirtió al adolescente en un personaje mediático de manera inesperada. Sin embargo, lejos de quedarse como una simple curiosidad futbolística, Morgan aprovechó los años posteriores para construir un negocio que acabaría situándole entre los emprendedores de mayor éxito del Reino Unido. CCon el paso de los años, el crecimiento de su marca de bebida espirituosa fue meteórico. El producto logró hacerse un hueco en el competitivo mercado de las firmas premium y sumar embajadores y apoyos mediáticos de primer nivel, entre ellos figuras como Ronaldinho o Floyd Mayweather. El propio Hazard, sin ser imagen oficial, sí que se prestó una década después a llevar a cabo diversas acciones promocionales en las que, de alguna manera, se llamaba a la reconciliación tras aquel incidente. El siguiente capítulo ha llegado con la adquisición de la marca por parte del gigante estadounidense de bebidas Sazerac. Aunque los términos exactos del acuerdo no se han hecho públicos, diversas informaciones sitúan el valor de la operación alrededor de los 300 millones de libras, una cifra que confirma el extraordinario crecimiento experimentado por la compañía en apenas una década.

articles.title: Michigan's Nate Marshall makes changes off field, becoming force on it
articles.summary: Michigan edge rusher Nate Marshall wanted to change. He knew he had to.
articles.body:
ANN ARBOR — Michigan edge rusher Nate Marshall wanted to change. He knew he had to. And a new football staff, determined to make him accountable off the field as well as on, gave him the push he needed.

Marshall and the Wolverines are coming off a 17-10 upset of Oklahoma last Saturday, Sept. 12, and he sealed the win with a sack of quarterback John Mateer , a moment he described as "surreal."

The last nine months have been real, though, a pivotal, make-or-break time.

"I definitely feel like I had to make some change," Marshall told reporters Tuesday night, Sept. 15, after practice. "I finally brought it within myself to make the change."

Kyle Whittingham, hired late last December as head coach after 21 seasons in the same role at Utah, was a catalyst for Marshall's change. At Whittingham's first news conference of the football season a few weeks ago, he praised Marshall's growth while alluding to some issues.

"Nate Marshall, who had some struggles in spring, some things that I wasn't real pleased with off the field, has really grown up in the last eight months," Whittingham said. "Knock on wood, hopefully he can stay on that trajectory. He's one of the best pass rushers on the team, if not the best pure pass rusher. He's got a real talent for bending the edge and getting his hips turned and getting to the QB."

Marshall is an emotional player, Whittingham said, who needed to reel that in.

"He needs to be commended, because the first few months were kind of rocky with Nate," Whittingham said. "He's really settled in and proud of how far he's come. If he can stay on the track he's on right now, he's got a very bright future."

Marshall wasn't attending class, and Whittingham wasn't having it.

"I was missing a lot of class earlier in the year, and that was just something I couldn't do, especially with this new coaching staff," Marshal said.

The previous football staff did not offer much guidance, Marshall said. Whittingham and his staff arrived with expectations the players would attend class and laid out clearly defined punishment if a player skipped.

Marshall's first missed class was punished by making him go through 6 a.m. lift in the weight room alone on a Saturday. A second miss meant not only an early morning lift for him but also for the rest of the players in his position group. A third miss, which he never had, would have punished the whole defense.

"They knew I was gonna get right," Marshall said of his teammates. "They trusted me."

And for good measure, there was always the threat of a phone call to Marshall's mother from defensive coordinator Jay Hill.

"That's what I didn't want happening," Marshall said. "I fill my parents in on everything, and they know I always have things to do better."

Marshall is majoring in psychology, attending class and proudly announced he earned Academic All-Big Ten.

While Marshall has made changes on the academic side, he also changed his approach to practice and football. He agreed with Whittingham's assessment that he's emotional and has tried to scale back. That epiphany came late in camp.

"I came a long way in terms of having to hold my tongue," Marshall said. "I used to be a guy just out there having fun, a lot of emotion, just letting it rip. But (Whittingham) has taught me, just let your game speak for itself."

Whittingham and Marshall have a closer relationship these days.

"Now that I've turned the page," Marshall said.

Marshall knew he needed to change and has worked, with some pushing, to get there. The journey has been challenging, and along the way to accountability, he has found a lot he likes about himself.

"It's been a process, I'll say for sure," Marshall said. "Had a lot of things to clean up, character-wise, but I cleaned it up now, and I feel very great about myself as a player and as a man."
authors: Angelique S. Chengelis, The Detroit News

articles.title: Man City and Chelsea join Real Madrid in race for 15-year-old Manchester United prodigy
articles.summary: Real Madrid’s pursuit of Manchester United prodigy JJ Gabriel is becoming increasingly complicated, with Manchester City and Chelsea now also keeping close t...
articles.body:
Real Madrid 's pursuit of Manchester United prodigy JJ Gabriel is becoming increasingly complicated, with Manchester City and Chelsea now also keeping close tabs on the teenager's situation.

According to ESPN Brazil , the Premier League duo have joined Real Madrid and Barcelona in monitoring the 15-year-old, setting up a potential battle for one of the most highly regarded young talents in English football.

Gabriel became a major talking point recently after his representatives informed Manchester United that the youngster wants to leave the club "immediately".

The development has put his long-term future at Old Trafford under serious discussion, although Manchester United have not abandoned hope of changing his mind.

JJ Gabriel can leave Manchester United next year

The current situation is complicated by Gabriel's age, as the teenager will turn 16 on October 6, allowing him to sign a youth contract with another club.

Manchester City and Chelsea are also interested in JJ Gabriel. (Photo by Alex Livesey/Getty Images)

He cannot yet sign a professional contract, with that option only becoming available once he turns 17.

That has created a window for clubs across Europe to make their move, with both Real Madrid and Barcelona already aware of the situation.

For Real Madrid, the interest appears particularly advanced, as the Spanish giants have already considered how they would develop him if a transfer is completed.

As previously outlined, the plan would be for Gabriel to begin with Real Madrid Castilla, the club's reserve side, rather than immediately being placed into the first-team picture.

Manchester City and Chelsea enter the race

Real Madrid are closely tracking the Manchester United prodigy. (Photo by Alex Livesey/Getty Images)

Real Madrid's plans, however, could now face competition from closer to home.

Sources say Manchester City and Chelsea are following Gabriel's situation closely, adding two major English clubs to a transfer picture that already includes both Spanish giants.

Manchester United, meanwhile, still want to retain their academy jewel. The club remains hopeful of persuading Gabriel to stay at Old Trafford despite the stance taken by his representatives.

For now, no move has been completed, but with Gabriel approaching his 16th birthday and several clubs tracking developments, his next contract could become one of the most closely watched youth transfers of the coming months.

articles.title: Premier League lets Arsenal defender off the hook for kick to Chelsea goalkeeper’s face
articles.summary: Arsenal’s win over Chelsea has one piece of legacy controversy – kick from a defender which many fans thought should be a red.If you enjoy Talk Chelsea cover...
articles.body:
Arsenal 's win over Chelsea has one piece of legacy controversy – kick from a defender which many fans thought should be a red.

If you enjoy Talk Chelsea coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content.

Arsenal defender Gabriel Magalhaes has been cleared of violent conduct by the Premier League's key match incident panel.

Five minutes into the exciting game at the Emirates, a scramble on the floor at a set piece lead to a kick from the Brazilian making contact with Chelsea goalkeeper Emi Martinez 's face.

"The panel unanimously supported the referee's call of no red card," the KMI ruling said.

"Multiple players were on the ground competing and challenging for the loose ball, and the action of Gabriel was not deemed to be an act of violent conduct or serious foul play."

Gabriel gets away with more set piece shenanigans

As much as it is galling to see Arsenal (who already exploit the set piece rules so ruthlessly) get away with this, we do have to agree that it was more reckless than dangerous. Gabriel was trying to kick the ball, and connected with Martinez instead. He should have been booked, and the goal ruled out (which ultimately it was anyway) but a red would have been so far, especially in the form of retrospective action.

Let's get our revenge on the pitch, not off it.

Levi Colwill is first choice right now, but if he slows down there are lots of players wanting to take his place. He spoke a little about that pressure.

articles.body:
Jonas Urbig was signed by Bayern Munich to become Manuel Neuer 's understudy and eventual successor. The 23-year-old emerged as a solid goalkeeper in the absence of Neuer, putting in impressive shifts in the Bundesliga and Champions League. Therefore, he's about to get rewarded for his rapid rise to prominence.

Per a report from Bild (as captured by X account @iMiaSanMia ), Urbig earned a call-up to the German national football team as a planned back up to Marc-André ter Stegen who is the starting goalkeeper. Urbig could be joined by fellow goalkeepers Finn Dahmen from FC Augsburg and former Bayern goalkeeper Alexander Nübel, now at Beşiktaş.

With Neuer's time on the pitch for Die Mannschaft already at its conclusion, with his tenure at Bayern soon to follow, this is Urbig's chance to showcase his abilities on the international stage and make a case for himself to become an eventual starting goalkeeper. Urbig joined the national team at the 2026 World Cup as a training goalkeeper.

articles.title: Fantasy football IDP Week 2 rankings at DL, LB, DB
articles.summary: Week 1 revealed safer tackle floors, breakout rookies and injuries that could force IDP managers to rethink several trusted defensive options.
articles.body:
IDP fantasy football managers enter Week 2 with something more useful than preseason projection: one full slate of NFL snaps that exposed safer workloads, fresh injury concerns and several rookies ready for larger roles.

Jordyn Brooks stays No. 1 overall in my Week 2 rankings, while Aidan Hutchinson and Kyle Hamilton lead the defensive line and defensive back boards. Week 1 changed the supporting cast more than the stars.

You can find my overall and position-by-position rankings tables at the bottom of the article.

Week 1 reminded IDP managers why Hutchinson belongs at the front of the defensive line tier . He recorded five tackles, two sacks and two tackles for loss against New Orleans , while his 10 pressures supplied the repeatable part of the performance.

Detroit also blitzed on 43 percent of Saints dropbacks. That left Hutchinson as the centerpiece of an aggressive front instead of a player living on two lucky finishes.

T.J. Watt delivered the week's loudest fantasy line: four tackles, two sacks, three tackles for loss and a pick-six against Atlanta . He sits fifth among defensive linemen because splash plays can swing weekly scoring, even though tackle-heavy linebackers remain safer overall.

Maxx Crosby stays second after recording 1.5 sacks, while Raiders teammate Kwity Paye 's two-sack debut deserves attention. Paye remains a wait-and-see option until his snap share and pressure rate hold for another week.

Will Anderson Jr. and Nick Bosa complete the top four. Both offer steadier roles than chasing last week's box score.

USA TODAY NETWORK-Wisconsin via Imagn Images

Brooks kept his familiar floor with nine tackles in Miami's loss, so one modest fantasy result does not dislodge the top-ranked linebacker. Jack Campbell remains second after seven tackles.

Blake Cashman holds the No. 3 overall spot because Minnesota again treated him as its green-dot, every-down defender. His role against Chicago creates another strong tackle environment.

The rookie results require more patience. Tampa Bay's Josiah Trotter produced 10 tackles, two tackles for loss, a sack and a 38-yard interception return for a touchdown. That historic debut earns attention, but he remains LB41 while the role settles.

Arvell Reese played all 58 Giants defensive snaps, made five solo tackles and recorded a tackle for loss. His full-time workload matters more than the modest total, placing him at LB38.

Washington creates the week's biggest contingency. Frankie Luvu left the opener with a mild groin strain after 29 snaps. If he sits at Dallas , No. 21 Sonny Styles gains the clearer path to play-calling duties and every-down volume.

Hamilton stays DB1 because Baltimore can create tackles, pressures and coverage plays with his hybrid role, even after a quiet opener. Nick Cross , Budda Baker and Derwin James Jr. follow him. That veteran group still carries the safest Week 2 workload.

The rookies made a stronger first impression. Chicago safety Dillon Thieneman led his team with 10 tackles and rises to DB15.

Dallas safety Caleb Downs played 61 defensive snaps and turned his debut into eight tackles, a sack and a forced fumble. That makes DB27 a ranking with room to climb.

Two injury notes matter before lineups lock. Nick Emmanwori is DB5 on the strength of his versatile Seattle role, but ankle surgery kept him out of Week 1. His practice participation must confirm that aggressive ranking.

Minkah Fitzpatrick played only six snaps before suffering a groin injury and is expected to miss two to three weeks. He should come out of Week 2 lineups, and his absence leaves Dane Belton and Andre Cisco with more opportunity for the Jets.

Week 1 should inform these rankings, not control them. Prioritize defenders whose snaps, alignment and play-calling jobs can recreate production. Treat turnovers and touchdowns as bonuses instead of promises.

articles.title: Saudi club Al Taawoun faces fine, stadium closure over Diogo Jota chants
articles.summary: Taawoun football fans chanted late Portugal player Jota’s name at Al Hilal’s Neves, prompting Ronaldo to call for a ban.
articles.body:
Saudi Pro League side Al Taawoun have been asked by the country’s football body to play their next two home matches behind ⁠⁠closed doors and have been handed a fine of 100,000 riyals ($26,640) after supporters chanted the name of the ⁠⁠late Portugal forward Diogo Jota during their match against Al Hilal.

The Discipline and Ethics Committee of the Saudi ‌‌Arabian Football Federation (SAFF) announced the sanctions on Al Taawoun ⁠⁠on ⁠⁠Tuesday, three days after Taawoun fans appeared to make chants referencing ⁠⁠⁠⁠Jota at Ruben Neves during the Saudi Pro League match.

Al Hilal midfielder Neves was a close friend ‌‌and former teammate of Jota, who died in a car crash in Spain last year alongside his brother Andre Silva. Neves was among the pallbearers at Jota’s funeral.

Videos circulated on social media appeared to show sections of ⁠⁠the crowd chanting “Jota” during Al ⁠⁠Hilal’s 6-0 win over Al Taawoun. Neves reacted by pointing to his eye and then towards the sky before saying after ⁠⁠the match: “I hope they don’t go to pray afterwards.”

The chants ⁠⁠sparked widespread criticism, including from Al-⁠⁠Nassr captain Cristiano Ronaldo, who urged authorities to take strong action and called for the fans to be banned from football stadiums for life.

In response to an Instagram post showing the footage, Ronaldo commented from his personal account.

“The league must take action and punish this kind of fan behaviour,” said the football superstar.

“This is no longer football, and there have to ⁠⁠be limits. People who behave like this should never be ⁠⁠allowed to enter a stadium again.”

Al Hilal filed a complaint with ‌‌SAFF, describing the chants as offensive and unacceptable, while Al Taawoun condemned ‌‌the ‌‌behaviour and said it did not represent the club or its supporters.

articles.title: Man Utd: JJ Gabriel wants to leave - what happens now?
articles.summary: On the night JJ Gabriel was supposed to become Manchester United's youngest player in history, the scramble is on to persuade him not to quit.
articles.body:
Before what was intended to be a historic night at Old Trafford, Manchester United are still digesting the reality that JJ Gabriel wants to leave.

The club have been left reeling at the sudden downturn in relations.

Only a week ago Gabriel scored a hat-trick on his Uefa Youth League debut at Leigh that seemed to be the prelude to becoming United's youngest player in history by making his debut against Brighton in the Carabao Cup third round on Wednesday.

Now United are scrambling. Chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox are involved in talks they hope will result in their 15-year-old reversing his plan and choosing to stay.

A belief that promises have been broken and a certainty over Gabriel's current abilities and eventual destiny mean trust is low.

Real Madrid, Barcelona and Paris St-Germain are among the European heavyweight clubs monitoring the situation. So what happens next?

All England's leading clubs have seen it first hand given he was named Under-18 Premier League player of the year last season, even though he was only 14 when the campaign began.

He scored 23 goals in the Premier League Under-18 competition and three in the FA Youth Cup. He was the star man in a United side that reached the Premier League Under-18 cup final and the FA Youth Cup final. He was the Premier League Under-18 Player of the Year and United's Under-18 Player of the Year.

The achievements and accolades were in recognition of a player who has balance, pace, close control and a powerful shot. This season he has shown a willingness to get stuck in to try and win the ball back.

"The best 15-year-old in Europe," was how the forward was described by one United source recently.

United Under-21s coach Adam Lawrence made a salient point in the aftermath of that Uefa Youth League victory over Sabah FK.

"The first thing in my job is not to ruin him," said Lawrence. "When you have a talented player like JJ, you obviously don't want to stifle their freedom and their creativity."

Talent like that grabs attention and is not confined to these shores. Real, Barcelona and PSG focus on elite youth players. That is what is happening here.

United's initial response to the publicity around Gabriel's future was to say privately that they would try to persuade him his future was best served staying where he is.

They also advised that Gabriel's registration with them runs until the end of the season.

That may well buy them time when it comes to potential moves to Premier League rivals. But what about European giants?

Gabriel has a European Union passport. His mother is of Greek-Cypriot heritage and his father won two caps for the Republic of Ireland.

In 2016 the Court of Arbitration for Sport rejected an appeal by Argentine club Velez Sarsfield - who tried to block one of their 16-year-old players moving to Manchester City - on the basis he was a dual Argentine-Italian national and, as an EU national, should be allowed to transfer to a club within the European Union even though he was coming in from an external country.

West Brom received no compensation when a 16-year-old Louie Barry left for Barcelona in 2019 as Fifa ruled that West Brom failed to formally offer him a scholarship.

West Brom had claimed 130,000 euros (£111,000) in training compensation. Barry left Barca for Aston Villa for just under £1m six months later.

The worst-case scenario for United is Gabriel walks away when he turns 16 on 6 October and they end up with no compensation for a player whose market value, even at this tender age and with so much promise unfulfilled, can be measured in millions.

What are the Premier League rules for academy players?

In the past 24 hours there has been a backlash against Gabriel and his family, for the direction he is taking and around his professionalism and attitude.

Sources close to the player believe this is massively unfair and overlooks the dedication and commitment which means he is so well-regarded by so many clubs.

In addition, he is not the first young player to have a difference of opinion over their future direction with their club.

Jadon Sancho was 17 when he stopped training at City to force through a £10m move to Borussia Dortmund in the belief that he would play more often in Germany than under Pep Guardiola.

Morgan Rogers was Barry's team-mate in the West Brom side that reached the FA Youth Cup semi-final in 2019. Within three months he had left for City, a move completed on his 17th birthday.

Sources feel that, in meetings with the United hierarchy that led to Gabriel committing his short-term future to the club last summer, promises were made over his career path that have not been kept.

He did start to appear in senior training sessions, initially under Ruben Amorim and then Michael Carrick, but speculation around a senior debut last season, which could only be in the FA Cup, was doused by Under-18s coach Darren Fletcher, who had by now taken the senior team manager's role on an interim basis following Amorim's dismissal. Fletcher felt it was too early for Gabriel.

It had been anticipated that Gabriel would feature during United's pre-season programme.

His absence from the trip to Helsinki for a meeting with Wrexham on 18 July was put down to the date he returned for pre-season training.

He was part of every squad after that, but played only once, for eight minutes against Atletico Madrid in Stockholm.

Did that lack of action sow the seeds of discontent? Gabriel travelled to Trondheim for a meeting with Rosenborg on 24 July. Carrick used 11 substitutes that day. Gabriel was one of two United players who did not come on. Five of those who did have left, either permanently or on loan.

It was noted that 18-year-old Tynan Thompson was given a 45-minute senior debut against Leeds United at Croke Park - another game Gabriel travelled to but was not involved in - three weeks after his arrival from Tottenham.

Nevertheless, it was felt Gabriel was likely to become United's youngest player this autumn - probably in the EFL Cup.

While the third-round draw delivered an Old Trafford rematch with Brighton, United's Champions League schedule opened up another avenue.

It is conceivable that Azerbaijani champions Sabah could be the least difficult home game Carrick's side have this season.

United were 3-0 up at half-time and Carrick had used all five substitutes by the 72th minute.

But Gabriel was not among them. As with Max Dowman at Arsenal last season, Uefa's registration rules meant that, because he was 15, Gabriel could only feature if he was named on United's A list of players.

It is not entirely clear why that did not happen. United named a maximum of 25 players, but among them was midfielder Manuel Ugarte, who will not play until after the registration window opens again in January because of a knee injury. Thompson was also on the list.

United coaches have previously suggested that Gabriel is not yet at the physical level required to be a senior player. Sources close to the player reject this.

They also cite Sir Matt Busby's saying "if you are good enough, you are old enough", and see how Arsenal gave Dowman his chance at 15 and Bayern Munich gave Lennart Karl his debut at 17 - and wonder why United have not done the same.

articles.title: Paco Esteban 'rompe' en Italia
articles.standfirst: Primer paso en la élite para el delantero español, que debutó con el Lecce en Serie A tras ser el Pichichi del primavera la pasada campaña
articles.summary: Primer paso en la élite para el delantero español, que debutó con el Lecce en Serie A tras ser el Pichichi del primavera la pasada campaña
articles.body: Paco Esteban ya ha dado el primer paso. Debutó este fin de semana en la Serie A con el Lecce, en el Via del Mare, y fue un momento emocionante al máximo: delante de una afición que lleva meses siguiendo su evolución y que ya le había marcado como uno de los jóvenes talentos más queridos del club. Su entrada al campo, ante el Monza, en un partido que terminó con victoria del Lecce (3-2), fue el estreno soñado después de años de trabajo en la sombra y de pelear por llegar al primer escalón. El punta, nacido en 2006, empieza a asomar ahora al máximo nivel después de pasar por las canteras de Villarreal, Atlético o Real Betis, desde donde llegó a Puglia. En Lecce tienen claro el tipo de talento que están manejando. La temporada pasada fue el 'capocannoniere del Primavera', con 21 goles, una cifra que le permitió ganarse el reconocimiento de la afición y llamar la atención de técnicos y especialistas que siguen el fútbol de formación en Italia y Europa. El Lecce no llegó hasta Paco Esteban por casualidad. El club del sur de Italia ha construido en los últimos años buena parte de su proyecto sobre una política de 'scouting' internacional, buscando jóvenes talentos en distintos mercados y apostando por su desarrollo. Hace un año, esa estrategia llevó al delantero español hasta Puglia. Un delantero al que el Lecce quiere dentro Los movimientos en verano ya dejaron claro que Paco Esteban es ‘talento a seguir’. Hubo opciones para salir a la Eredivisie, con varios clubes neerlandeses siguiendo su situación, y también aparecieron alternativas procedentes de la Serie B italiana. La respuesta del Lecce fue siempre la misma: la apuesta pasa por hacerlo crecer dentro del club. Por eso, hizo la pretemporada y conquistó su sitio con Eusebio Di Francesco. También apareció el nombre del Elche, atraído por un perfil joven y por la conexión del futbolista con la ciudad ilicitana. Esa posibilidad, por ahora, ha quedado en espera. El gol en la sangre El estreno liguero no fue, en realidad, su primera aparición con el primer equipo. Paco Esteban ya había tenido minutos en agosto, en pretemporada dejó algún destello en forma de gol y pudo debutar con el primer equipo en la Copa de Italia, ante el Palermo. Fueron cinco minutos en un partido con poca sustancia, pero una señal: el jugador estaba progresando por el camino correcto. La Serie A es otra dimensión. Este paso se lo ha ganado con fútbol. Es, además, una historia familiar ligada al gol. Paco Esteban es hijo del delantero del mismo nombre, que desarrolló buena parte de su carrera en el fútbol español, con etapas en clubes como Elche y Málaga. Y su hermano, Sergio Esteban (campeón de Europa Sub-19), es también uno de los los futbolistas con más proyección y más futuro del Atlético de Madrid. Ahora le toca a Paco escribir su propia historia. El primer capítulo en la Serie A ya está escrito. El siguiente objetivo es sencillo: trabajar, tener minutos y buscar el gol. El gol que lleva en el ADN.

articles.title: Ole Miss reportedly serves lawsuit papers to LSU's Princewill Umanmielen days before Tigers' game at Rebels
articles.summary: Umanmielen followed Lane Kiffin to LSU just after Ole Miss was eliminated from the College Football Playoff.
articles.body:
Princewill Umanmielen was officially served papers in Ole Miss' lawsuit against him. And those papers arrived just days before Umanmielen returns to Oxford as a member of LSU 's football team.

According to ESPN , the Tigers ' edge rusher was served outside the LSU football facility on Tuesday. Ole Miss had filed suit against Umanmielen and former offensive lineman Devin Harper this summer after the two had followed coach Lane Kiffin to LSU.

Ole Miss officials requested payment from Harper and Umanmielen on Jan. 16 and Jan. 22, respectively, according to a timeline provided to ESPN in July. Neither player responded within the 30-day deadline to make the payment. Umanmielen and Harper were served with a summons on Aug. 14 and didn't respond within the 30-day window.

Ole Miss officials requested payment from Harper and Umanmielen on Jan. 16 and Jan. 22, respectively, according to a timeline provided to ESPN in July. Neither player responded within the 30-day deadline to make the payment.

Umanmielen and Harper were served with a summons on Aug. 14 and didn't respond within the 30-day window.

The school accuses both Harper and Umanmielen of breaking the revenue-sharing contracts they signed with the school in January. According to the suit, both players signed new deals with Ole Miss in early January, when the Rebels were alive in the College Football Playoff. However, both players entered the transfer portal in the days after Ole Miss' loss to Miami in the semifinals and went to join Kiffin at LSU.

Kiffin had been LSU's coach for approximately a month when those deals were signed. He left Ole Miss at the end of the regular season after attempting to figure out a way to both be the new coach at LSU while simultaneously coaching the team in the College Football Playoff.

Ole Miss, understandably, did not want to go for that. It promoted defensive coordinator Pete Golding to replace Kiffin for the playoff and beyond.

The school is asking for nearly $1 million in penalties from both Umanmielen and Harper.

Umanmielen has been one of the best edge rushers in college football so far this season. He had two sacks in the Tigers' blowout win over Clemson in Week 1 and then added three more sacks in the Tigers' victory over Louisiana Tech in Week 2.

articles.title: What's gone wrong for Chelsea talent Kendry Paez?
articles.summary: Kendry Paez was one of the world's best young talents when Chelsea signed him as a 16-year-old. Three years later, he's playing for the Under-21s. So what has gone wrong?
articles.body:
Attacking midfielder Kendry Paez has finally pulled on a Chelsea shirt, three years after agreeing a move to Stamford Bridge - albeit for the club's Under-21s.

Chelsea agreed a £17.27m deal to sign Paez from Ecuadorian side Independiente del Valle in 2023 when he was 16, but his development has not progressed as quickly as many expected.

Now 19, Paez made his first appearance in Chelsea colours for Cobham Next Gen, the club's newly-renamed Under-21 side, as a 12th-minute substitute in a 4-1 win away to Arsenal on Saturday.

It comes after new manager Xabi Alonso said the midfielder was "not in my plans" and Chelsea listed him as an academy player on the club website.

Chelsea explored the possibility of a loan move in English football, but Fifa regulations left the club unable to send him overseas after using all six of their available international loan slots.

With 27 caps for Ecuador, an appearance at this summer's World Cup and a reputation as one of South America's brightest young talents alongside Blues team-mate Estevao Willian, what has happened to Paez?

Paez is a record breaker and a headline maker.

He became the youngest debutant and goalscorer in Ecuadorian top-flight history at the age of 15 before making his debut in the Copa Libertadores, South America's equivalent of the Champions League, later that same season.

Later in 2023, aged 16 years and 131 days, he made his second appearance for Ecuador, becoming the second-youngest South American international to feature in World Cup qualifying after Diego Maradona.

A month later, he became the youngest South American to score in a World Cup qualifier in a 2-1 win away to Bolivia.

It was understandable, therefore, that Chelsea believed the attacker, who had two international goals and 18 caps when they agreed to sign him, was destined for big things.

Chelsea allowed him to train regularly with the first team before he was officially eligible to join the club following his 18th birthday.

They also provided security for Paez, his family and the family of international team-mate Moises Caicedo after violence broke out in Ecuador in early 2024.

A few months later, Paez was filmed in a New York strip club while away on international duty.

He initially impressed on loan at Chelsea 's sister club Strasbourg by winning September's Young Player of the Month award in the French top flight, but then came in for criticism from then-manager Liam Rosenior.

"We expect more, clearly," Rosenior said later that season. "I'm tired of using the excuse of the player's youth."

Despite Strasbourg's links to Chelsea through their shared ownership, the loan was cut short after one goal in 21 appearances. Instead, he joined Argentine giants River Plate on a two-year loan spell.

Sources in Argentina expressed similar concerns about his attitude when asked by BBC Sport. They point to a disappointing display in the 1-0 Superclasico defeat by fierce rivals Boca Juniors at the Monumental in April.

Shortly afterwards, Paez was named by club president Stefano Di Carlo as one of 15 players training away from River Plate's first team, although other sources felt he could have been given more opportunities.

His loan ended by mutual consent after Paez scored once in 14 appearances in 461 minutes for River Plate.

Ahead of the international break, concern has been expressed in Ecuador, having built him up as the country's next great attacking talent.

Michel Deller, the owner of Independiente, told Hincha Amarillo: "He's like a son to us. We care about him deeply.

"He's a good kid who's had a tough time and has made decisions that have complicated his life.

"We are always hopeful he'll show his exceptional talent one again but right now, it's up to him to decide what to do with his life."

These concerns are not dismissed completely by Chelsea or Paez's environment. However, there is a belief they are grossly overstated, highlighting he is owed time to grow as a player and person.

There was one reminder of Paez's quality in the dying moments of Cobham Next Gen's ( Chelsea Under-21s) defeat at Wycombe Wanderers in the EFL Trophy on Tuesday.

It was an outswinging cross from a short corner routine, which Harrison Bettoni tapped in during added time. He then put in another cross that caused havoc as Chelsea chased an equaliser in front of just 778 fans.

It was a much-needed boost for Spanish-speaking Paez, who appeared to stand alone from the other academy players before kick-off.

He did join in their warm-ups but mostly kept to himself before coming on in the 62nd minute.

Ultimately Chelsea lost, while Paez was a peripheral figure playing as a right-sided No 10, like Cole Palmer, in a system that mirrored Alonso's back-three shape.

That was until his flurry of activity late on.

Although he's not Chelsea 's youngest player, Paez has already made 70 appearances for Ecuadorian side Independiente and more than 100 senior matches in total.

It's something he can fall back on in a more than salvageable situation.

Chelsea have been encouraged by his attitude, having him back in the building at Cobham where he has trained in a stable and elite environment.

There is stability around him as family attended his recent match at Wycombe.

The Blues are also now able to monitor his development more closely, while academy matches are regularly attended by scouts from across the English Football League and beyond.

There is optimism from those close to Paez that he can impress and gain a first loan move in England in January, or one of the six international loan spots will become available for him to go overseas again.

It's more than possible he can rediscover the form that attracted Chelsea in the first place and fulfil the immense potential that made him one of South America's most coveted young talents.

articles.title: Everything Dabo Swinney Said About Benching Clemson's QB and Bill Belichick Relationship
articles.summary: After Tait Reynolds played most of the snaps in Saturday's win over Georgia Southern, Clemson head coach Dabo Swinney is going to roll with him as the starting quarterback for this week's game against Bill Belichick and North Carolina.
articles.body:
After Tait Reynolds played most of the snaps in Saturday's win over Georgia Southern, Clemson head coach Dabo Swinney is going to roll with him as the starting quarterback for this week's game against Bill Belichick and North Carolina.

Speaking to reporters leading up to Saturday's ACC matchup (beginning at 7:30 mark), Swinney explained Reynolds has passed Christopher Vizzina on the depth chart even with Vizzina suffering an elbow injury against Georgia Southern.

"He wasn't perfect," Swinney said in evaluating Tait's performance, "but you saw some things that we saw in the spring that we're like okay, now you see it in real time. We just feel like that's the decision that needed to be made. And you hate it because it's really there for CV, but I mean this is a performance deal, and he had a lot of opportunity on things that you grade him every play, and things that were there for him to keep the job, he just didn't do the routine things that he needs to do. Nothing to do with anything else, but that's where we are, and so we made the change. We knew we had a kid coming here that is pretty special, and we think he's got a bright, bright future. Hopefully he gets off to a good start this week, but he'll get all the reps and we're gonna go play."

Looking ahead to Saturday's matchup with North Carolina (starts at 27:05 mark), Swinney described Belichick as "probably the best" coach in the history of the sport.

Swinney added that he has been able to spend "hours" around Belichick since he started coaching in the ACC and one of his takeaways is to "just be who you are" from their interactions with each other.

"He doesn't really get distracted by noise," Swinney said of Belichick. "I mean, he just kind of does his job. I think that's what he's always said, right, is 'do your job.' And I think he just shows up and he loves football, and I think he just focuses on doing the job."

Swinney also admitted he still gets a little starstruck when he coaches against Belichick.

"It's an honor to coach against him, really," he said. "Sometimes I still can't believe he's the coach at North Carolina, but he is, and we've gotta play him."

This will be the second meeting between Swinney and Belichick. Clemson took care of business in the first matchup last year with a 38-10 victory at Kenan Stadium in Chapel Hill.

Saturday's game will be played at Memorial Stadium. The Tigers will look to get over the .500 mark after splitting their first two games of the season. North Carolina is 2-0 with wins over TCU and East Tennessee State.

Clemson's quarterback situation will be a key focus of this game. The Tar Heels defense has allowed a total of 13 points and 353 passing yards in their two wins.

Reynolds is a true freshman who was a 3-star recruit in the 2026 class. He finished 16-of-27 for 178 yards through the air and ran for 38 yards on 14 carries against Georgia Southern.

Vizzina led the Tigers on their lone touchdown drive in the game. He also threw an interception and averaged just 2.7 yards per attempt on seven pass attempts. The offense got five field goals with Reynolds, who averaged 6.6 yards per attempt.

A loss would drop Clemson to 1-2 after three games for the second consecutive season.

articles.title: El Levante-Athletic, bajo alerta naranja
articles.standfirst: AEMET la ha activado para la tarde de este miércoles por fuertes lluvias en la provincia de Valencia
articles.summary: AEMET la ha activado para la tarde de este miércoles por fuertes lluvias en la provincia de Valencia
articles.body: La Comunitat Valenciana está vivirá los primeros episodios de tormentas, tan comunes por estas fechas, en las últimas horas de este miércoles. La AEMET ha activado la alerta naranja por fuertes lluvias en la toda la provincia de Valencia, donde se espera 40 l/m2 en una hora y granizo de hasta 4 cm. Sin embargo, a pesar de esta previsión, el partido entre el Levante y el Athletic sigue en pie. articles.title: 366 millones en fichajes, cero goles marcados y De Zerbi se regodea: "En Italia sería el mejor entrenador"
articles.standfirst: El Tottenham aún no conoce la victoria en Premier esta temporada
articles.summary: El Tottenham aún no conoce la victoria en Premier esta temporada
articles.body: El Tottenham no levanta cabeza. Tras eludir el descenso 'in extremis' el pasado curso, los 'Spurs' tiraron la casa por la ventana para evitar un nuevo descalabro y tratar de recuperar su sitio en el 'Big Six'. El equipo que entrena Roberto de Zerbi invirtió 366,35 millones de euros en fichajes. Sólo Manchester City (526,2) y Chelsea (406,7) gastaron más dentro de las grandes Ligas. Sin embargo, las incorporaciones de Tonali, Mateus Fernandes, Sávio, Van Hecke, Adarabioyo... no han surtido el efecto deseado. Al menos, por ahora. El Tottenham marcha decimoséptimo en Liga, cuarto por la cola, con dos puntos de 12 posibles. Hay, sin embargo, un dato más 'sangrante': aún no saben lo que es marcar en Premier: perdieron con Brentford (3-0) y Newcastle (0-2) y empataron ante Nottingham Forest (0-0) y Everton (0-0). "Llegué la pasada temporada cuando estábamos de mierda hasta las cejas", aseguró De Zerbi, que prefiere ver la botella medio llena: "En Italia, por ejemplo, sería el mejor entrenador del mundo… ¡porque conseguí dos porterías imbatidas en los últimos dos partidos!". Los 'Spurs' sólo han ganado uno de los seis partidos que han disputado. Golearon al Charlton (5-1), de Segunda división, en Copa de la Liga. De poco les sirvió. Cayeron en dieciseisavos contra el Liverpool (3-1). “Lo sentimos por el resultado. Estamos frustrados. Creo que fue injusto. Tenemos que aceptarlo y ser más fuertes que este momento de mala suerte”, admite el técnico italiano. Por si fuera poco, hay marejada de fondo con Richarlison, al que han excluido de la lista de la Premier. "No jugará ni aunque esté disponible. Ni siquiera en la Carabao Cup. Perdimos contra el Brentford 3-0 con Richarlison. Tal vez lo olvidásteis. Sólo por recordarlo. Al comienzo de esta temporada hablé con él muchas veces para convencerlo de que se quedara y no quería. No puedo ir todos los días a rezarle para que se quede”. "¿Por qué?", se limitó a responder el atacante brasileño a través de 'Instagram'. 'RDZ', sin embargo, mantiene la esperanza: "Sufrimos porque los resultados son nuestra vida. Si perdemos, lo lamentamos, nos entristecemos, nos decepcionamos, nos frustramos. Es duro, pero el proyecto está comenzando. Creo que cuando hagamos 'clic' vamos a ganar muchos partidos y marcar muchos goles". Conserva, también, la fe en Solanke: "Dom es un chico sensible. Necesita tener plena confianza, y por mi parte, tiene muchísima confianza. Creo que puede marcar entre 10 y 15 goles, seguro. Ya lo logró con el Bournemouth, así que ¿por qué no podría repetirlo con el Tottenham? Es el mismo deporte”. Un deporte en el que los 'Spurs' necesitan volver a ganar. Cuanto antes.

articles.title: Mbappe, Vinicius and Konate court controversy with Ceuta solidarity shirts
articles.summary: The three footballers partially covered up a slogan in solidarity with Ceuta worn by the rest of their teams.
articles.body:
Real Madrid players Kylian Mbappe, Vinicius Junior and Ibrahima Konate are in the spotlight having obscured a solidarity message on their shirts linked to Ceuta, the Spanish enclave which has become a political flashpoint over the influx of migrants from Morocco.

All players from Real Madrid and their Spanish competitor Elche wore a white shirt carrying the slogan: “Todos somos caballas” (“We are all mackerels”) over their team shirts prior to their La Liga match on Tuesday.

However, Mbappe, Vinicius Jr and Konate rolled up the white shirts to their chests, covering some of the text, before walking onto the pitch and removing them as players shook hands before kickoff.

In a sign of how divisive the episode has become, some commenting on social media saw the move as the players’ disregard for the issue, which has prompted solidarity protests across Spain, while others praised the trio for wearing the shirt in the first place. The players were also lauded by some for obscuring the message.

The slogan is a reference to the people of Ceuta as caballas is a nickname for locals.

The two clubs had asked the players to wear the shirt.

“Before the start of the match between Elche and Real Madrid, players from both teams took to the pitch at Manuel Martinez Valero Stadium wearing shirts that read ‘todos somos caballas’ as a show of solidarity with Ceuta,” Real Madrid said on its website.

Social media videos showed Vinicius and Mbappe rolling up their shirts after putting them on as they waited to step out.

According to FIFA’s rulebook, clothing worn by players “must not have any political, religious or personal slogans, statements or images”.

Rule 4.5, pertaining to players’ clothing and equipment, also bans players from revealing undergarments that show political, religious, personal slogans, statements or images, or advertising other than the manufacturer’s logo.

However, footballers displaying such messages have avoided fines or bans in recent years.

Al Jazeera asked FIFA if the La Liga players or clubs will face any sanctions for displaying the message. The global governing body pointed out that any disciplinary action falls under the remit of La Liga, the Spanish football federation (RFEF) and European football body UEFA.

La Liga, RFEF and UEFA did not respond to Al Jazeera’s request for a comment.

Morocco’s Ezzalzouli criticised for wearing shirt

Several La Liga clubs have shown solidarity with the people of Ceuta over the past week, with Real Betis’s Moroccan winger Abde Ezzalzouli wearing the shirt prior to a match against Villarreal on Monday.

Ezzalzouli, who was born in Morocco and raised in Spain, was criticised by Moroccan fans amid ongoing rifts between Spain and Morocco over the Ceuta crisis and various other points of tension.

The 24-year-old said he did not aim to disrespect Morocco.

“I want to make one thing clear – at no point was the shirt referring to the people of Ceuta used with a political objective or out of contempt for my people, the Moroccan people,” said Abde in an Instagram post.

The former Barcelona winger described it as a social gesture in support of the population of the city “regardless of their nationality”.

“This is not an apology to anyone,” he added. “I will continue to hold my head high and represent my roots with pride and sacrifice.”

Real Betis are due to play a friendly against Ceuta on October 1 in Seville to raise funds and show support for the city.

Political tensions over migrant crossing

More than 70,000 people entered Ceuta from nearby Morocco on July 30 and 31 in a surge that left scores dead and raised concerns in some European nations over migration.

Most returned in the hours following their arrival, but several thousand remain in Ceuta.

Last week, Morocco’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said there was no evidence of Rabat’s involvement in the crossing.

Ceuta is an autonomous Spanish city on the northern coast of Africa bordering Morocco. Ceuta and Melilla are the only remaining European-held territories on the African mainland.

Ceuta’s location makes it one of the main entry points for people trying to reach Europe. The enclave is protected by high border fences, surveillance systems, and a permanent deployment of Spain’s Civil Guard and National Police.

Morocco does not recognise Madrid’s sovereignty over both enclaves, regarding them as occupied territory.

articles.title: Los cinco 'nueves' que buscan un hueco en la lista de De la Fuente
articles.standfirst: La selección vuelve con el ánimo de seguir ganando
articles.summary: Mínimas variaciones en la primera lista de Luis de la Fuenye tras ganar el Mundial
articles.body: El Mundial es historia. En doble sentido. Lo conseguido el pasado 19 de julio en Nueva Jersey es una obra para la eternidad. Es la segunda estrella en la camistea de España, la que es estrena en una ventana con cuatro partidos en la Liga de las Naciones: Inglaterra (Wembley, día 26), Croacia (el 29 en el Sánchez Pizuuán y el 6 de octubre en Split) y República Checa (el 3 de octubre, en Oviedo). Pero también es pasado. Porque el mensaje que sale desde Las Rozas no se detiene en lo logrado, en vanagloriarse por ser la selección que es a la vez campeona de Europa y del mundo. "Queremos seguir ganando". Es una frase que se repite en el cuerpo de trabajo de De la Fuente. No hay más norma que prolongar una línea de trabajo que ha llevado a España a dominar el mundo y, además, lucir marcas históricas de partidos sin derrotas. Como no puede ser de otra manera, el bloque está creado porque el Mundial ratificó la construcción de una idea, de un grupo, de un equipo. La sólida osamenta de la selección se activa tras el éxito, pero no hay puertas cerradas. Hay cosas que están cantadas. Como el regreso de Fermín, al que una lesión en la última jornada de la Liga pasada dejó sin ser campeón del mundo. Una de las novedades estará en el lateral derecho. La retirada de Marcos Llorente abre una plaza en una posición que hace un año vivía con la esperanza del regreso de Carvajal y que ha dado un giro radical a causa de una de las grandes sensaciones del Mundial: Pedro Porro. En la lista de trabajo de la selección hay laterales derechos bien apuntados: Álex Jiménez (Fiorentina), Fresneda (Sporting de Portugal), Víctor Gómez (Braga), Andrés García (Getafe), aunque éste se encuentra lesionado... Pero De la Fuente tiene una solución muy natural que nace en el bloque mundialista. Dos de sus centrales (Eric García y Marc Pubill) pueden jugar como laterales derechos con absoluta normalidad. El barcelonista suma en esa posición todo lo que ha jugado esta temporada. Si esa es la vía, la puerta de la selección se puede abrir de nuevo para Dean Huijsen. El madridista se quedó sin Mundial por su desfondamiento la pasada temporada y ahora vuelve a estar al nivel que le condujo a la selección en marzo de 2025. La vía de Mosquera (Arsenal), explorada en marzo, cuenta con el problema de que lleva lesionado desde inicios de septiembre, aunque se le espera para este fin de senana. Desde la sub 21, al que no se quita ojo es al realista Jon Martín. En el resto de posiciones las cosas están muy claras. Incluso con Zubimendi, aunque el donostiarra haya perdido sus galones en el Arsenal. Pero sí hay un puesto con aires de cambio: el de tercer ariete. Con Oyarzabal y Ferran como intocables, la pieza que puede variar es la que fue Borja Iglesias en el Mundial. La presencia del gallego del Celta en la Copa del Mundo estaba enfocada a la aparición de un momento especial. Al final se limitó a solo un par de minutos contra Portugal en octavos. El Panda apenas ha jugado en lo que va de temporada y la competencia se le ha disparado. En cabeza, por perfil de delantero, Roberto Fernández. El ariete del Espanyol suma seis goles en seis partidos y su perfil es el de un delantero centro puro y duro. Los mismos goles suma Sergio Camello. El delantero del Rayo tiene un perfil distinto, más de aparecer en el área que vivir en ella. En esa pelea están metidos Gonzalo (debutante ante Irak en Riazor antes de que España viajara a Chattanooga), Espí y Toni Martínez.

articles.title: Ohio State, Texas, Oregon Top The Athletic's CFB Roster Spending Estimates in New Report
articles.summary: Big Ten and SEC schools reportedly make up the five highest-spending teams in college football in terms of NIL allocations to their rosters.
articles.body:
Big Ten and SEC schools reportedly make up the five highest-spending teams in college football in terms of NIL allocations to their rosters.

The Athletic's Stewart Mandel, David Ubben and Sam Khan Jr. published NIL estimates for 68 teams from the Power Four conferences—and Notre Dame—on Wednesday, and Ohio State leads the way with an estimated budget of between $49 million and $54 million.

Here is a look at the entire top 10, featuring two Big Ten schools at the top, and six from the SEC:

Fanbases That Should be Worried after Week 2 😨

It is likely no coincidence that each of the 14 highest-spending teams in college football in terms of NIL are ranked inside the Associated Press Top 25 after Week 2 of the 2026 season.

Out of the 25 highest-spending programs, 18 of them are currently ranked inside the top 25.

Eight of the 10 highest-spending teams are AP top 10 teams, including the No. 1 Texas Longhorns, who are coming off a come-from-behind, 24-23 win over now-No. 6 Ohio State.

The lone exceptions are No. 4 Indiana and No. 2 Georgia, who rank Nos. 13 and 19 in estimated NIL spending, respectively.

After Week 2, the biggest outlier in terms of spending compared to ranking is Oregon, which has the second-highest spending floor and ceiling.

Following a narrow win over Boise State in Week 1 and a shocking loss to Oklahoma State in Week 2, the Ducks are now the No. 21-ranked team in the nation.

However, led by quarterback Dante Moore, Oregon is still considered one of the most talented teams in the nation, and head coach Dan Lanning's squad is a strong candidate to bounce back and reach the College Football Playoff by year's end.

articles.title: VAR controversy: Pressure for quick decisions obvious in rushed derby review
articles.summary: The controversy surrounding the VAR decision to allow Erling Haaland's winner in the Manchester derby has rumbled on for days, so what led to the error?
articles.body:
"Quick, quick, quick, quick! Go, go, go, go, go!"

The words of video assistant referee Matt Donohue as he rushed through the review to award Erling Haaland's winning goal in the Manchester derby.

No doubt Donohue was simply trying to be as efficient as possible, but it led to one of the most catastrophic VAR errors the Premier League has seen.

Donohue and his assistant VAR, Blake Antrobus, inexplicably failed to notice that Enzo Fernandez was three yards offside before he tried to head the ball.

The goal was given, and Manchester City beat Manchester United 1-0.

Refereeing has always been a goldfish bowl of scrutiny and pressure, heightened by the introduction of VAR.

The Premier League made a "more efficient application of VAR to reduce delays" one of its football principles for the season.

Has the game tried to prioritise speed over accuracy?

Rushed and chaotic rather than calm and collected

The urgency in Donohue's voice was all too apparent.

"Let's go, let's go, let's go, let's go!"

It was a panicked exchange between the VAR and the replay operator. Not calm, collected and methodical. Rushed and chaotic. The opposite of how a video official should operate.

Officials hear repeatedly - from fans, pundits, radio phone-ins and newspaper columns - that VAR has to be quicker. That delays are not acceptable.

In the Premier League stakeholders' survey - which includes managers, coaches and supporters - the key theme for improvements to VAR was the speed of decisions.

This has to create pressure - but it is no excuse for such an error.

City boss Enzo Maresca had some sympathy speaking on Wednesday, though he was of course the beneficiary of the gaffe.

"To make a decision in 10, 20 seconds is not easy for them," said Maresca.

"Sometimes they make mistakes. I make mistakes, players make mistakes. It's part of our job."

Referees' chief Howard Webb has taken the desire for quicker reviews on board, but it is still a balancing act.

There has been a positive impact, as far as the stats go.

VAR delays - including the referee making an announcement to the crowd - have been reduced, from an average of 46 seconds per game to 36 seconds season-on-season.

Yet the only other VAR mistake, the failure to award a penalty to Arsenal at Aston Villa , also arguably came about because the incident was cleared too quickly.

Completing a VAR review in the shortest possible time is not about skipping steps. And it was a critical mistake by Donohue and Antrobus.

Speed is a factor, but the most serious error in process came before Donohue tried to rush through the attacking phase.

Donohue asked the replay operator to stop the video on the first replay when Josko Gvardiol touched the ball to cross into the area. He then went immediately into the semi-automated offside technology.

The VAR team should have assessed the full picture, from the playing of the cross to the head of Haaland. This would have provided awareness of Fernandez's position and impact.

They did not, and the events inside the penalty area were not considered until the attacking phase was looked at.

By then, all that mattered to Donohue and Antrobus was whether Fernandez touched the ball. This would have created a new phase and placed Haaland offside.

Donohue has received much of the criticism, but arguably Antrobus' involvement, or lack of, was just as influential.

The AVAR's contribution to the entire review was to utter "no, yeah" about the potential touch by Fernandez. This was one second before Donohue uttered the words "final decision is goal, check complete".

Antrobus' role is to provide the checks and balances, to make sure the VAR has not missed anything. This fell short.

There has been only one lengthy VAR delay this season, in the game between Brentford and Sunderland . A Dan Ballard goal was ruled out for a subjective offside against Kevin Danso.

Antrobus was the AVAR in this game, too. There was a great deal of criticism in some parts of the media for that delay, which took over four minutes.

Could that have played on Antrobus' mind on Sunday? We cannot know for sure.

Ironically, Antrobus played a crucial role in steering VAR Tim Wood to the correct offside decision against Danso.

There is also the role of the support VAR, who sits in the operations room next to the match hub at Stockley Park and can intervene on points on protocol.

Aware of what was unfolding with the review, no action was taken.

It would still have been salvageable in the period between the goal being scored and the kick-off.

Maresca criticises focus on controversial winner

Analysis: A clear VAR mistake Published 2 days ago

VAR did not even consider if Fernandez was offside - Webb

Pro Ref has placed a huge level of training and resources into VAR in an attempt to make it as efficient and accurate as possible.

But when an error of this magnitude happens, no amount of investment can mask the failure.

There have been calls to appoint VAR specialists, yet this is exactly what Donohue is - in the Premier League's definition.

Three seasons ago, Pro Ref asked for candidates interested in becoming video officials.

All those who applied were put through aptitude tests. About 15 made it through to the final stages of training, of which 10 have officiated games in the Premier League.

One of those is Donohue, who on Sunday was the video official for the 65th time.

Such as been Donohue's development that he is now on the international list, appointed to Uefa club competition qualifying ties over the summer.

Donohue has made mistakes, in fact very few do not. It shows how difficult the role is.

The only two VARs to have a clear record over the last two seasons are Nick Hopton and Neil Davies, both graduates from the same accelerated programme.

Persuading referees to hang up their whistles and spend their professional lives in the VAR room is not easy, nor does it guarantee success.

Lee Mason and Mike Dean, the Premier League's only full-time VARs appointed after retirement, were both dismissed by Webb just a few months into his tenure because of a catalogue of errors.

One of the only leagues which has a full team of officials who only act as VARs and never go out on the pitch is Spain's La Liga and second division - yet one glance at the headlines there will tell you the controversy is no different to that in England.

At the start of last season the VAR completely missed that a player who scored a goal was in an offside position when the ball was played.

Pro Ref will have questions to answer over its processes and why a VAR is rushing so desperately over a review in one of the biggest games of the season.

That did not happen when West Ham's stoppage-time equaliser against Arsenal was ruled out last season. It took over four minutes - but the VAR came to the correct outcome.

The obsession with speed threatens to undermine all the work behind the scenes.

But that feels like a football problem and not one caused solely by the actions of the VAR.
